subject: Discovery debrief + POC launch plan
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena@clearpath.ai>, Marcus Voss <marcus@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery debrief + proposed POC scope

Hi Lena & Marcus —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick debrief and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we jump into a POC. I captured the key pain points, what success looks like, and the minimum scope we recommend to validate uplift.

Pain points / goals you emphasized:
- Inaccurate entity extraction from customer emails (~20% error for product names and dates) which drives manual triage.
- API latency spikes during peak support hours causing timeouts for a downstream workflow.
- Need to ensure customer PII never leaves ClearPath systems (data residency + KMS).

Success metrics for the POC (30 days):
- Entity extraction F1 > 0.87 on the provided sample set (baseline ~0.68).
- 99th percentile inference latency < 200ms for 512-token requests under a 5 rps sustained load.
- No data persisted externally; KMS integration and audit logs in place.

Proposed 30-day POC scope (minimal to be meaningful):
1) Data & test set: you share 2k anonymized support emails (we'll provide a scrub script).
2) Model + prompts: evaluate 2 model variants, run the prompt eval suite (we'll bring a starter prompt set).
3) Infrastructure: Redwood Private (VPC) trial w/ dedicated capacity for consistent latency.
4) Success criteria + checkpoints: weekly syncs, end-of-week eval report, go/no-go at day 30.

Owners & immediate asks:
- ClearPath: Lena (data + test set), Marcus (security/KMS point).
- Redwood: Ben (commercial lead), Monica (customer success/contact), me (technical PM / ops).

Access/setup checklist (high level):
- Share sanitized sample emails via S3 link (we will provide a presigned upload).
- Whitelist Redwood egress IPs for the VPC peering.
- Exchange KMS policy and role ARN for keybind testing.

I attached a short POC charter and access checklist to accelerate legal & infra alignment. Proposed kickoff: Monday, 14 Dec — does that work?

Thanks,
Chloe

--
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0129

Subject: Re: Discovery debrief + proposed POC scope

Chloe —

Appreciate the clear summary. Quick answers from our side: all the pain items are accurate. A couple clarifications and constraints:

- We can provide 2k anonymized emails by Friday 11 Dec. We will remove direct identifiers but keep product names and dates in place for eval.
- Security: we need the KMS integration to be customer-managed; our security team requires an audit trail and monthly log export. Marcus will own that.
- Latency: the 200ms 99th target is aggressive for our peak of 7 rps — is that at 512 tokens for your dedicated capacity SLA? We want to ensure realistic load shape.

Kickoff on Monday 14 Dec should be fine; we prefer a 30–45 minute ops-focused meeting to confirm access and timeline. Also, can you share the presigned S3 upload instructions and the IP ranges you need whitelisted?

Thanks — Lena

- Deal: RDW-4691. We'll provision a 30-day Dedicated trial (no charge) that includes pre-allocated GPU capacity to stabilize latency for the eval.
- Pricing: if we move to production after POC, I will follow up with a reserved-capacity quote; for now there are no evaluation fees.

Thanks all — finalizing the kickoff logistics for Monday 14 Dec, 10:00–10:45 PT. Agenda below (ops-first):

1) Introductions & roles (5 min) — confirm owners: Lena (data), Marcus (security), Monica (success), Chloe (tech PM), Ben (commercial)
2) Access walkthrough (10 min) — presigned S3 upload, VPC peering checklist, IP whitelist, KMS role exchange
3) Data & prompt plan (10 min) — what the scrubbed dataset looks like, sample prompt set we'll run, evaluation metrics
4) Benchmark plan (10 min) — synthetic warmup, steady-state 5 rps and a peak run at 7 rps, latency and throughput measurement points
5) Timeline & checkpoints (5 min) — weekly sync cadence + day 30 demo and pass/fail criteria

Immediate action items (before kickoff):
- ClearPath: upload anonymized sample to the presigned S3 link we send (deadline: Fri 11 Dec EOD).
- ClearPath: provide the KMS role ARN and contact for audit-log delivery (Marcus).
- Redwood: send presigned S3 upload link, and provide the egress IP list for VPC firewall rules (see related links).
- All: confirm kickoff attendance and any additional security docs required.

Attachments included: poc-charter-CLR-4691.pdf (short charter), access-checklist-CLR.csv (IP ranges and steps), mutual-action-plan-CLR.docx (MAL). Also shared: Drive folder with the starter prompt evals and a Link to the HubSpot deal.

If there are no blockers we'll treat Monday's session as the formal POC start. If you prefer a different kickoff time, say so and we'll adjust.

Looking forward — Chloe
